_about: Liquid CO2 bought and delivered to the greenhouse. The price comes from the block's input file (EUR per kg), or from price_per_kg when the block has no file. TO CHECK: the values are placeholders.
price_note: fixed CO2 price per kg (market currency), used only when the block has no input file
fixed_cost_note: yearly fixed cost of the supply (tank and evaporator rental, contract), market currency. TO CHECK: placeholder 0
max_kg_h_note: the most CO2 the supply can deliver per hour (evaporator); none = as much as the greenhouse needs. TO CHECK
